record.student_summary: You can do your summer internship as CPT once your department confirms it counts for credit and you get your new I-20. We will extend your program to December 15, 2027 so your June 1 to August 15 dates fit. Send your offer letter today and wait for the new I-20 before starting work. You can travel over winter break with a signed I-20, but your visa must be valid when you return — renew it abroad if needed. Your one summer of full-time CPT will not block OPT after graduation.
